title: Pork Afritada
description: A Filipino-style slow-cooked pork stew with potatoes, carrots, sausage and tomatoes in a soy and fish sauce broth.
ingredients: 2 large potatoes (total weight 400g/14oz), peeled and cut into large chunks
16 Chantenay baby carrots, tops cut off and peeled
steps: Add all the ingredients to the slow-cooker pot, season well and stir thoroughly.
Cook on high for 5-6 hours, or on low for 7-8 hours. The pork should be tender and easy to pull apart.
Remove the bay leaves before serving.
notes: Oven method: 190°C/170°C fan, Gas Mark 5 — increase chicken stock to 500ml, cook in casserole with lid for 1.5 hours. Also works with chicken thigh fillets (3-4 hrs high / 6-7 hrs low) or lean diced beef (same times as pork).
